_readme: Functional features only: things a user or an integrating system can DO, anchored to code. Not listed on purpose: schema/migrations, OpenAPI, logging, datasource/config wiring, error envelope, test gates, observability probes, localisation plumbing, design docs and test harnesses - they support features but are not features. Anchors: ui.slices = intelligence-ui src/features/<slice>; ui.files = extra UI files; service = controller class names; lexie = route file + optional URL regex; lexie_run = the use case lexie-ai's POST /run serves; tests = path prefixes per repo (service prefixes are packages under src/test/java/com/lextr/intelligence/). Everything else (endpoints, test files, UI wiring status, live checks) is derived from the code by build_feature_catalog.py.

features.name: Ask Lexie a question
features.what: Type a question in the Lexie panel; Lexie picks the use case, launches a run and renders the answer inline (impact, trend, digital twin, analytical, lineage, swarm) or opens the right workspace.

ui.where: Lexie panel (button in the top bar)

steps: Open the UI, click Lexie, ask "What is the impact of a change to BHCK2170 on the Y-9C?"
Ask "Show the trend of total assets on the Y-9C"
expect: The panel launches a run and shows an inline answer for the use case, or an honest refusal naming what is missing
known_issues: In dev mode the panel uses the built-in reference host: it keyword-matches the question and returns a fake run with no output, so no real answer appears
Outside dev mode it posts to /api/v1/intelligence/run, which no service exposes (the service's run endpoint is POST /run), so every question fails
There is no question-to-use-case resolver behind the HTTP host (RESOLVER_NOT_EXPOSED)

does: Ask "Which report gives exposure by counterparty?" and get ranked reports (UC10), with Open in Analytical Assist
Ask "Write me the rule for COAF6360000 / BHCKF636." and get a rule draft with Accept — open in Rules Authoring (UC11)
Ask "When is the Y-9C due, and where is the approval sitting?" and get status (UC12)
Ask "What does HC-C line 4.a mean, and where else is it referenced?" and get a definition plus references (UC8)
Ask "If BHCK4435 takes a +$10K topside, what does it touch?" and get an impact list (UC2)
Ask "How has total assets trended the last 6 quarters?" and get a chart or dataset (UC3)
Ask "Show me net income." and be asked which line you meant (needs input)
Ask "Has the Y-9C been approved yet?" and see it routed from UC8 to UC12 (route out)
Every answer carries a review banner and its confidence

features.name: Impact analysis (UC2)
features.what: Change a value and see what it propagates to: every downstream line, the direction and size of the effect, and where the walk stopped.
steps: POST /api/v1/impact/run on intelligence-service with a node and a delta
POST lexie-ai /run with use_case UC2 and a numeric delta_amount
expect: Propagated impacts per downstream node, with bounds/stops recorded
The non-numeric delta is refused with RUN_INPUT_INVALID naming the fields
known_issues: Only reachable through the API: the Lexie panel does not launch real runs (see Ask Lexie)

does: Open Impact Analysis from the sidebar and describe a change
See each affected line with direction and size, and the impact graph
See which edit checks the change touches
Open the impact drawer for a line; the result carries a review banner

features.name: Trend analysis (UC3)
features.what: Read the history of a line across periods and get a verdict (in trend / out of trend) with a chart and a short narrative.
steps: POST lexie-ai /run with use_case UC3 and a series
expect: A verdict, the periods analysed and a narrative; too few periods gives UNDETERMINED, not a guess
known_issues: Only reachable through the API (see Ask Lexie)

features.name: Ratio reconciliation (UC4)
features.what: Compute regulatory ratios from their components and reconcile them against reported values, showing each breach.
steps: Open Analytics › Ratio Reconciliation and run it
expect: Each ratio with its computed and reported value and whether it reconciles

features.name: Anomaly detection (UC5)
features.what: Scan metric series for statistical outliers (z-score and IQR fences) and send anomalies to human review.
steps: Open Analytics › Anomaly Detection and run a scan
POST /api/v1/anomaly/run with a series that has one spike
POST with fewer than 3 points per series
expect: The spike is flagged with severity and a review item is created
Too few points is refused, not scored

features.name: Forecast projection (UC6)
features.what: Project a metric forward under scenarios and show the projection curve with its bands.
steps: Open Analytics › Forecast Projection, pick a scenario and run it
expect: A projection per scenario with its curve

features.name: Peer benchmarking (UC7)
features.what: Compare a metric against a peer cohort and see the quartile the institution sits in.
steps: Open Analytics › Peer Benchmarking and run it
expect: The quartile distribution and the institution's position in it
known_issues: The peer cohort chips are fixed in the UI, not loaded from the service

features.name: Semantic and reference query (UC8)
features.what: Ask what a line, concept or reference means and get the definition from the semantic layer.
steps: Open Analyst Workspace › Semantic & Reference and ask what BHCK2170 means
expect: A definition, or a refusal naming the missing capability
known_issues: lexie-ai refuses UC8 with RUN_ADAPTER_UNBOUND until a Lextr Core host adapter exists, so a real answer is not possible yet

features.name: Analyst digital twin (UC9)
features.what: Ask a multi-step question; the orchestrator routes it across use cases (for example UC8 then UC12) and preserves any refusal from a step.
expect: The answer, the steps taken and where it routed; a refused step is shown as refused
known_issues: Only reachable through the API (see Ask Lexie)

features.name: Analytical assist: find and build reports (UC10)
features.what: Describe the report you need; get matching reports with confidence and grounding, refine them in natural language, add derived attributes, resolve ambiguous filter values and open a filed report instance.

ui.where: Lexie panel inline answer (AnalyticalWorkspace); the sidebar item is a roadmap placeholder

expect: Candidate reports with confidence and grounding, or a refusal naming the missing readiness
known_issues: Analyst Workspace › Analytical Assist shows only a roadmap placeholder
Report Store and domain resolution use stubs until Lextr Core's endpoints exist

does: Ask for a report in the ask bar and see ranked matches
Build a plan: choose the dataset and banding (use this / change)
Propose operations to refine the report
A question that is really operational is handed off (Answered by UC12 →)

features.name: Rules and logic assist (UC11)
features.what: While authoring a rule in Lextr Core: understand, build, check and compare the rule with a copilot that checks correspondence and conflicts.

ui.where: Embedded in Lextr Core's rule editor; Analyst Workspace › Rules & Logic Assist only shows a Core-owned note

expect: Findings for the draft; the session lists its runs
known_issues: lexie-ai's /run refuses UC11 with RUN_ADAPTER_UNBOUND (no rules adapter bound), so the assist cannot produce findings yet
The Intelligence UI has no working screen for it; it is meant to be hosted by Core

does: Understand, build, check and compare a rule
Edit the draft and insert operands; an unregistered operand is refused
Request registration of a missing operand
Open How this works

features.name: Operational data query (UC12)
features.what: Ask for operational figures (current balance, due items) and get the answer with its evidence from the host's data plane.
expect: An answer with evidence, or a reasoned refusal
known_issues: lexie-ai refuses UC12 with RUN_ADAPTER_UNBOUND until a Lextr Core host adapter exists

features.name: Supervisory radar
features.what: Map regulatory alerts to their compliance impact across reports.
steps: Open Analytics › Supervisory Radar and run it
expect: Alerts with their impact matrix

features.name: Calculation lineage
features.what: Extract how a metric is derived as a graph (nodes, edges, depth) and flag circular dependencies.
expect: The derivation graph; a cycle is reported and sent to review
known_issues: Only reachable through the API (see Ask Lexie)

features.name: Agent swarm consensus
features.what: Run a task through several agents that vote; a failed consensus is sent to human review.
steps: POST /api/v1/swarm/run with a root task and protocol
expect: Votes, the final decision and whether consensus was reached
known_issues: Only reachable through the API (see Ask Lexie)

features.name: Explain a variance (UC1a)
features.what: Pick a reporting line and period; get why it moved: drivers, evidence (trend, anchor, reconciliation), confidence and a review banner.
steps: Open Analyst Workspace › Variance Analysis, pick a line and run it
expect: Drivers with evidence and confidence, and a review banner; missing confidence shows as unavailable
known_issues: The Variance Analysis screen posts to /api/v1/intelligence/run, which no service exposes, so running from the UI fails; the lexie-ai API works

does: Pick a line and see the variance explanation with its drivers and an AI disclosure
See the evidence beside it: trend sparkline, anchor block and reconciliation bar
Open the explanation drawer with the full evidence
Open the triggers panel from the workspace

features.name: Drill into a variance (UC1b)
features.what: Walk down from a report line to its material children in a graph, one level at a time, with a result per node.
steps: Open the drill view from a variance result and click through the nodes
expect: Each node appears once with all incoming edges; clicking a node shows its result
known_issues: The drill view shows sample data only (fixed nodes); no endpoint serves a drill walk

does: Drill the variance graph node by node from the report line down

features.name: Re-run a variance with my input
features.what: Add your own driver hypothesis and re-run; it is shown separately and never counted as a system driver.

ui.where: Variance result › Re-run with my input

steps: From a variance result, enter a hypothesis and re-run
expect: A new run linked to the original, using the latest governed preset; your driver shown as analyst-attributed
known_issues: Needs a first run to exist, and the UI's first run fails (see Explain a variance)

features.name: Reporting cycles and variance detection
features.what: Open a reporting cycle, list available cycles and entities, and detect which lines moved materially.

ui.where: No screen; lexie-ai API and the /demo console

expect: A cycle is created; detected lines come back with their tiers

features.name: Review variance explanations
features.what: Work a review queue: accept, correct or reject each explanation; see approved analyses per cycle and review metrics.

ui.where: Risk & Compliance › AI Risk & Controls (sample data); lexie-ai API

expect: The accepted analysis leaves the queue, appears as approved and is counted in the metrics
known_issues: The AI Risk & Controls screen shows built-in sample data, not the live queue

does: Work the review queue: read the answer and its evidence
Accept, correct or reject; confidence is shown as a signal only
Opt in to capture a correction for training

features.name: Variance thresholds, model settings and cycle close
features.what: Set materiality thresholds (with a preview), change runtime model settings with history, map source nodes, check completeness, close and reopen a cycle.
expect: Changes take effect and are recorded in history

features.name: Variance audit trail export
features.what: Export the tamper-evident audit trail of an analysis.
expect: Every action on the analysis, hash-chained
known_issues: The chain's JSON canonicalisation is not RFC 8785 (open owner decision)

features.name: Variance demo data and demo console
features.what: Generate or remove demo reporting periods and try VarianceAI in a disposable console at /demo.
steps: Generate a demo period, then delete it
expect: Only generated periods can be deleted

features.name: Upload regulatory documents
features.what: Upload one or many documents with a description and classification; each file comes back accepted, rejected or failed with a reason (unsupported type, duplicate, missing classification).
steps: Open Content › Knowledge Hub and upload a PDF, an unsupported file and a duplicate together
expect: Each file shows its own disposition and reason code
known_issues: The screen calls lexie-ai's /api/v1/variance/knowledge routes, but the dev server proxies /api to intelligence-service, which does not serve them, so uploads from the UI fail in dev

does: Open + Knowledge Ingestion and describe the version (form_code required)
Load files: duplicates, empty, unsupported and >25 MB files are refused with a reason; Remove all refused
Watch each file parse; a file that cannot be extracted fails with an instruction
See the suggested classification and have a person confirm it (Confirm classification)
Record a per-document drop

features.name: Search and chat over the knowledge base
features.what: Search the ingested documents and ask questions in a chat that answers with citations.
steps: Ask a question in the Knowledge Hub chat
expect: Ranked passages; chat answers cite their sources
known_issues: Same proxy problem as uploads: the UI chat fails in dev

does: Ask the knowledge base a question and see the answer with its evidence and chunks
Replay a question as of a date, in similarity or intent-resolved mode

features.name: Knowledge graph and document relations
features.what: Link documents to each other and to reporting concepts, browse neighbours and take snapshots.
expect: The new relation appears among the neighbours

features.name: Document assurance
features.what: Measure how well the hub answers questions about a document (a graded exam) and show that separately from ingestion and approval.

ui.where: Not on any screen (the AssuranceTab component exists but nothing mounts it)

expect: NOT_MEASURED, never a score of 0
The small exam is refused with EXAM_TOO_SMALL

does: Run assurance on a document and open the run
See not-measured shown as not measured, never as a score

features.name: Presets: create, approve and activate
features.what: Create an analysis preset in a wizard, then move it draft → observed → operational; activation needs model-risk approval and a second person.
steps: Create a preset in the wizard
Try to activate it as the same person
Activate it as a second person after it is observed
expect: Same-person activation is refused; resolve returns only an operational preset, never a draft
known_issues: The preset list shows sample data
Approve envelope posts to /api/intelligence/presets/{id}/envelope/approve, which no service exposes

does: Create a preset in the 7-step wizard (instruction, grounding by reference, runtime controls)
Submit it for review
Have MRM approve or reject it (approver cannot be the author)
Activate it draft → observed → operational, and retire it
See the audit trail card for the preset

features.name: Skill registry
features.what: See every registered skill, model and calibrator; approve for model risk, change status, tag and enable or disable them.
steps: Open Governance › Skill Registry and open a skill
expect: Sync adds new skills as drafts and never activates them; status changes follow the approval rules
known_issues: The inventory grid shows sample data; the status, approval and tag actions call the real API

does: Browse the registered skills with id and version
See each skill's tool scope and risk tier
Move a skill draft → observed → operational (MRM-gated) and enable or disable it
Retire an adapter or delete a version

features.name: Approvals inbox
features.what: See every step waiting for you across governed items and approve or reject it; the Core surface can view but not decide.
steps: Open Governance › Approvals Inbox and decide an item
expect: The decision is recorded on the estate ledger; the CORE surface is refused

does: See every pending step with its step ring and track strip
Approve or reject a step
Open the item a step belongs to (deep link)
See the audit trail card for the item

features.name: Model registry
features.what: Browse the models available to Intelligence and their history.
expect: The models in use
known_issues: Built-in sample data only; no endpoint behind it

does: Browse the models and open a model's history

features.name: Runtime policies
features.what: See the policies that gate every run and reload them from their source.
steps: Stop OPA and call a gated endpoint
expect: Loaded policy packages are listed; with OPA down, calls are denied (OPA_UNAVAILABLE), never allowed
known_issues: The Runtime Policies screen shows sample data, not the loaded policies

does: Browse the registered OPA packages (reference and scope, never the rule body)
Open a policy's detail and its audit trail card

features.name: Role mapping
features.what: See which roles map to which Intelligence functions.
expect: The role-to-function table
known_issues: Built-in sample data only; no endpoint behind it

does: Browse role → domain → capabilities

features.name: Evidence ledger: who was involved and export pack
features.what: For a run, report or other anchor, see who was involved and the coverage, and export a verifiable evidence pack; hand-back and erasure are governed.

ui.where: Governance › Evidence Ledger (needs the governance.audit.view capability and a deployment flag)

expect: Involvement and coverage for the anchor; a downloadable pack; erasure is refused (no authorities named yet)
known_issues: Hidden in the dev UI: the reference host withholds governance.audit.view
Erasure authorities ship empty, so every erasure is refused

features.name: Population reconciliation
features.what: Reconcile the lines filed in a report against the lines Intelligence analysed, and refuse when Core's inventory is missing.
steps: Covered by the service tests only; there is no endpoint
expect: Refusal when the inventory is missing; otherwise matched, missing and extra lines
known_issues: No endpoint or screen; Core's line inventory contract is still an ask to Core

features.name: Audit and evidence overview
features.what: An overview screen of audit activity.
expect: Audit activity
known_issues: Built-in sample data only; no endpoint behind it

does: Pick a subject and see both halves (Core acts and Intelligence reasoning) on one timeline
Step through the chain (◀ ▶) and switch between flow, time and history views
A leg that cannot be answered is shown as unanswerable, not as a pass

features.name: Training data and fine-tuning
features.what: Build governed training datasets from reviewed samples, freeze, attest and approve them, run fine-tunes that must pass an evaluation, and trace a model back to its data.
steps: Open Training › Training Data and create a dataset
Freeze, attest and approve it (approval by a second person)
expect: Each step is recorded; eligibility explains why a run is or is not allowed
known_issues: No trainer or evaluator is connected, and the training environment is switched off, so a real fine-tune cannot run

does: Capture a sample from a review correction, author one, or bulk-import
Curate candidates into the draft, then freeze it into a version
Attest masking on the version, then have MRM approve it
Initiate a fine-tune run; it must pass the evaluation gate before the model is registered with lineage
Rebind presets to the new model, monitor accuracy and revalidate flagged samples

features.name: Training sandbox probes
features.what: Try a scenario or a free-form question against a model without it ever counting as evidence, training data or assurance.

ui.where: Not mounted (the Sandbox workspace is declared unmounted)

expect: The probe is recorded on the non-evidential track
known_issues: It records a probe; nothing executes one yet

features.name: Confidence calibration
features.what: Monitor how well confidence scores match reviewer outcomes, and promote a new calibrator when it clears the thresholds.
expect: Metrics per calibrator; promotion below the threshold is refused

features.name: Rules chatbot
features.what: Ask questions about rules in natural language; answers stream back and the conversation is remembered per user.

ui.where: No Intelligence screen; lexie-ai API (used by Lextr Core)

steps: POST /api/v1/chatbot/ai/query with a question and context
expect: A streamed answer; clearing memory starts a fresh conversation
known_issues: No automated tests anywhere; needs an OpenAI key

features.name: Rule description and summary
features.what: Generate a plain-language description or summary of a rule, backed by a rule knowledge index you can refresh.

ui.where: No Intelligence screen; lexie-ai API (used by Lextr Core)

expect: Readable text for the rule; the index status updates
known_issues: No automated tests anywhere; needs an OpenAI key

features.name: MDRM recommendation
features.what: Suggest MDRM codes for a free-text description.

ui.where: No Intelligence screen; lexie-ai API (used by Lextr Core)

expect: Ranked MDRM suggestions
known_issues: No automated tests anywhere

features.name: Run API for Lextr Core
features.what: Core launches any Intelligence use case through one call and reads the run back; runs go to human review.

ui.where: No screen; the API Core calls

steps: POST intelligence-service /run with a use case and payload
POST lexie-ai /run with an unknown use case
expect: A run id and result; the run is readable afterwards; unknown use cases are refused, not guessed

features.name: Tenant administration and access rules
features.what: List tenants, run tenant admin operations and evaluate attribute-based access for a user.
expect: Tenants listed; an access decision per request

features.name: HSM signing
features.what: Check the hardware security module and run signing operations.
expect: The appliance status; an operation result
known_issues: No real HSM is connected

features.name: Resilience console
features.what: See the cluster topology and run failover or chaos operations.
expect: The topology

features.name: Streaming audit ingest
features.what: Ingest a batch of audit events and flag breaches as they arrive.
expect: Throughput and any breaches

features.name: Embed Intelligence in Core with tenant theming
features.what: Mount Intelligence inside Lextr Core (npm, Module Federation or the <lx-intelligence> web component) in inline, modal or drawer mode, with the tenant's logo and stylesheet.
steps: Mount <lx-intelligence> on a test page with a tenant config
Press Escape in a modal or drawer mount
expect: The tenant logo replaces the product logo; the overlay closes and focus returns

features.name: Governance profiles (DR-01)
features.what: Tenant-configurable governance profiles: which review gates apply at which risk tier, and who may sign.

ui.where: Not in the real UI (a roadmap card in the prototype)

steps: Look for Governance › Governance Profiles in the real UI
expect: The screen exists
known_issues: Not built in the real UI; the prototype itself only shows a roadmap card

does: Configure a profile per tenant
Set risk-tiered independence above the fixed floor

features.name: Drop profiles
features.what: Decide, per document family, what a parse deliberately does not ingest: engineering drops, and an SME ruling to keep or drop each candidate.
steps: Look for Governance › Drop Profiles in the real UI
expect: The SME can rule keep or drop on each candidate
known_issues: No screen and no endpoint; the proposer and the ruling view exist only as code

does: See candidates proposed from evidence (position, not frequency)
Rule Keep as content or Drop on each open question
See kept-and-why, decided rules and the audit trail

features.name: Document version approval and lifecycle
features.what: Take a document version through attest, submit for approval and approve or reject, then retire, supersede or roll it back.
steps: Open a document version in the Knowledge Hub and look for Attest / Submit for approval / Approve
Look for Retire, Supersede and Roll back
expect: Each action is available and recorded
known_issues: The real Knowledge Hub has none of these actions; only archiving exists, through lexie-ai's API

does: Attest a version
Submit it for approval, then approve or reject it
Retire, supersede or roll back a version

features.name: Row history on any list
features.what: Open the history of any row (a preset, a model, a review item, a training record) in a drawer.

ui.where: History button on rows in Model Registry, AI Risk & Controls, Audit & Evidence and Training Data

steps: Click the history button on a row in Model Registry
expect: A drawer lists that row's events
known_issues: The older history kinds show sample data (made-up actors and dates); only the five kinds added by LP-48.5 derive from record fields

does: Open any row's history in a drawer
